cards.claim: Bob Gracie played in the NHL.
cards.quote: Among the league's early stars was a Canadian forward named Bob Gracie, whose remarkable career would leave an indelible mark on the NHL. Born on December 8, 1910, in Ottawa, Ontario, Gracie grew up with a passion for hockey that would drive him to greatness. He honed his skills on the outdoor rinks of Ottawa, developing a lightning-quick shot and a keen sense of anticipation that would serve him well in the professional ranks. Gracie's big break came in 1932, when he signed with the Toronto Maple Leafs, one of the NHL's most storied franchises. The Leafs were a powerhouse team, having won three Stanley Cup championships in the previous five years, and Gracie was eager to contribute to their success. On November 12, 1932, Gracie made his NHL debut against the Boston Bruins at the Boston Garden.
